title: Peak learning rate 1e-3 -> 3e-3
description: Short budget, small model, cosine over wall-clock: a 3x higher peak with the same 200-step warmup. Everything else unchanged.
hypothesis: 1e-3 was never tuned for a 4-minute budget. Small transformers with AdamW and grad clipping usually tolerate 3e-3 and converge faster in a fixed step budget. Risk: instability early -> loss spikes.
